summary: Frontend-only regression tested the live /people experience on desktop and 390px mobile. People listing, totals, search, summary modals, add-person mock feedback, Carlos/Ana profiles, pending/history data, card details, receipt/payment feedback, theme toggle, mobile overflow, FAB, and Cards navigation passed.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. All people, balances, pending/history entries, card details, and action feedback are MOCKED/local-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live URL https://fox-ui-core.preview.emergentagent.com tested. Previous mobile Cartões/FAB overlap is resolved: at 390px Cards navigated normally to /cards and no horizontal overflow was observed.
rca of the issue: No unresolved People feature issue reproduced. Initial diagnostic failures were test-harness assertion/selector mistakes; clean targeted runs confirmed profile routing and Sonner feedback. External telemetry POSTs were observed but no app/backend/Supabase write requests were made.
